crossRefs.note: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house…
I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of…

translations.web: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
translations.bsb: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
translations.kjv: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace
translations.asv: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
